RHEA:33307 [('RHEA:33308', 'left_to_right', ['(2R)-2-O-(alpha-D-mannosyl)-glycerate(out) + N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein] => (2R)-2-O-(6-phospho-alpha-D-mannosyl)-glycerate(in) + L-histidyl-[protein]']), ('RHEA:33309', 'right_to_left', ['(2R)-2-O-(6-phospho-alpha-D-mannosyl)-glycerate(in) + L-histidyl-[protein] => (2R)-2-O-(alpha-D-mannosyl)-glycerate(out) + N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein]'])]
RHEA:23880 [('RHEA:23881', 'left_to_right', ['L-histidyl-[protein] + phosphoenolpyruvate => N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein] + pyruvate']), ('RHEA:23882', 'right_to_left', ['N(pros)-phospho-L-histidyl-[protein] + pyruvate => L-histidyl-[protein] + phosphoenolpyruvate'])]
